exposure: mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
cohort: A total of 1154 adult women from southern China, with a mean age of 36 years and mean BMI of 22, were included in the study.
finding: The study established a comprehensive baseline database of standard vulvar dimensions in southern Chinese women, revealing specific mean measurements for various parameters and demonstrating that vulvar parameters are influenced by mode of delivery and parity.
mod_finding: Women who underwent vaginal delivery had wider vulvas and larger vulvar parameters compared to those who had a cesarean section, and multiparous women had larger vulvas than those with a single vaginal delivery.
